## Classification levels

| Level | Rank | Handling |
|---|:-:|---|
| public | 0 | No restrictions. |
| internal | 1 | Readable by role baseline in the owning domain; steward can approve exceptions. |
| confidential | 2 | Data Owner approval; time-bound exceptions only; personal data masked unless role allows. |
| restricted | 3 | Data Owner approval; never granted through ad-hoc requests; always masked outside the owning domain. |
